title: Single warehouse management system vendor
cause: The WMS is a single-tenant install supported by one vendor with no exit plan
event: The vendor ends support or fails
consequence: Picking and dispatch stop at all three depots until a replacement is live
controls: Escrow agreement for source code; quarterly vendor financial check; exit plan drafted
review_trigger: Vendor misses an SLA two months running or announces a sale

title: Driver shortage in peak season
cause: Regional driver pool shrank 12% this year and agency rates rose
event: Not enough drivers are available for November to December peak
consequence: Missed delivery windows and contract penalties from two retail customers
controls: Peak contracts with two agencies signed; overtime pre-approved; route consolidation
review_trigger: Agency confirms fewer than 80% of booked drivers

title: Ransomware on depot laptops
cause: Depot laptops run an unsupported OS build and staff share a local admin account
event: Ransomware encrypts depot laptops and the file share
consequence: Depot dispatch runs on paper for days and customer data may be exposed
controls: EDR on all endpoints; shared admin account removed; offline backups tested monthly
review_trigger: Any EDR detection on a depot device or a failed backup restore

title: Fuel price spike
cause: Fuel is 31% of operating cost and contracts have no fuel surcharge clause
event: Diesel price rises more than 20% within a quarter
consequence: Margin on fixed-price contracts falls below zero
controls: Fuel surcharge clause added at each renewal; six-month hedge on 40% of volume
review_trigger: Diesel index up 10% in a month

title: Loss of ISO 9001 certificate
cause: Two depots have open non-conformities from the last surveillance audit
event: The certification body suspends the certificate at the next audit
consequence: Three tenders that require ISO 9001 are lost
controls: Corrective action plan; internal audit at both depots before the surveillance visit
review_trigger: Internal audit raises a major non-conformity

title: Flooding at the riverside depot
cause: The riverside depot sits in a flood zone and stock is stored at floor level
consequence: Stock is lost and that depot is closed for weeks
controls: Flood insurance in place; stock raised on pallets above 30 cm
review_trigger: Environment Agency flood warning for the site

title: Key-person dependency in route planning
cause: One analyst maintains the route optimisation scripts
event: The analyst leaves or is off for an extended period
consequence: Routes are planned by hand and fuel use rises
controls: Second analyst trained; scripts moved to version control with a runbook

title: Customer data in shared spreadsheets
cause: Customer delivery addresses are exported to spreadsheets for ad hoc planning
event: A spreadsheet is emailed to the wrong person or left on a shared drive
consequence: A personal data breach that may need reporting to the regulator
review_trigger: A misdirected email or a breach report
